subject: Private deploy — environment acceptance matrix & onboarding roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@therahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy — environment acceptance matrix & onboarding roadmap

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for agreeing to start the Private deployment onboarding this week. Attached is a lightweight acceptance matrix I drafted to accelerate the environment validation (env-acceptance-matrix.xlsx). The goal here is to get to a clear "go/no-go" for activation testing in the next 5 business days.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm BGP peer IPs and expected ASN for the transit/VPN (we've left fields in the matrix blank).
- Share the current firewall egress allowlist and whether you can open the three Redwood control-plane endpoints (listed in the matrix) from the management subnets.
- Provide an estimated maintenance window where we can perform a short activation test (approx 30 mins) without impacting production.

Attachments: env-acceptance-matrix.xlsx, network-diagram-v2.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) You fill the matrix cells for IPs/ASNs/ACL owners (send back by Tue EOD).
2) Redwood validates connectivity and schedules activation test (Wed/Thu).
3) Quick smoke run + brief triage call.

If useful I can loop in our networking lead (Marcus) to help with tunneling details.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Jordan / team —

Thanks — filling the attached matrix now. Quick answers inline and attachments included: Ther_Network_SA.pdf has our high-level network architecture and change window policy.

- ASN / Peering: Our ASN is 64512; we will peer on ip 10.200.1.2 (Thera) <-> 10.200.1.1 (Redwood).
- Tunnel: We prefer IPSec/IKEv2 with pre-shared keys for this initial activation test; will consider Direct Connect in Phase 2.
- Firewall/Egress: We'll open the three control-plane FQDNs listed in the matrix from our mgmt subnets (10.200.0.0/22).
- Maintenance window: Wed 26 Aug, 02:00-04:00 PT looks best.

I've uploaded a slightly modified network diagram and our security assessment (Thera_Network_SA.pdf). Also attaching the completed env-acceptance-matrix.xlsx in my reply (attached).

DocuSign: I've created the short SOW packet and sent the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/packets/6a7b-example

Let us know if you need our PKI root or any additional logs/configs.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Director, IT Ops | Thera Health
alice.nguyen@therahealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@therahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy — environment acceptance matrix & onboarding roadmap

Alice — appreciate the quick turnaround and the completed matrix. Summary / decisions: 

- Peering: ASN 64512 confirmed; we'll configure our side for 10.200.1.1 and coordinate BGP session parameters. Marcus will provision the tunnel using IKEv2 with PSK for activation.
- Windows: Activation test scheduled Wed 26 Aug 02:00-04:00 PT — Redwood test plan attached (see shared Drive).
- Security gating: Kimberly confirmed we only require standard TLS for control-plane calls; for the private CA option we will accept their root cert if supplied before the activation test.
- Paperwork: Signed SOW via DocuSign will unlock Dedicated pool provisioning (HubSpot deal RDW-TH-2026-0921).

Action items:
- Marcus: create the VPN config and send PSK to Alice (use secure channel) — due Tue 25 Aug EOD (note: slipped earlier, please prioritize).
- Alice / Thera: upload root CA if you want mTLS enabled — optional for activation.
- Jordan/Laura: once DocuSign is back, we'll trigger provisioning and send the activation runbook link.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleSharedDrive
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/RDW-TH-2026-0921

Thanks team — will mark this thread as the official onboarding runway and update once the VPN config is posted.
